Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 7
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely constrained the comparison to “officially credited directors only” and asserted Monster A Go-Go’s director as Bill Rebane (b. 1937) without verifying all directors involved. Monster A Go-Go was also directed (uncredited) by Herschell Gordon Lewis (b. 1926), who is older than Pasquale Festa Campanile (b. 1927). By excluding Lewis and not confirming Monster A Go-Go’s full directorial credits first, the Planner set up a flawed criterion that would lead to the wrong film being identified as having the older director.
